description: Constructing a cache record from a source URL with assorted boundary key handling: an empty URL (where the defaulted key mirrors it), an explicitly supplied empty key that is retained rather than defaulted, keys and URLs containing whitespace and non-ASCII characters, and mixed-case URLs kept verbatim.

cases.expected_output:
url=https://例え.com/画像.png
key=https://例え.com/画像.png

url=a b c/space file.png
key=  spaced key
